name: github-desktop-zh
description: GitHub Desktop 汉化补丁工具 - Rune 原生界面，一键汉化，支持还原

scripts.build:rune: npm run build:rune-assets && node scripts/cargo.cjs build --release
scripts.dev: npm run build:rune-assets && node scripts/cargo.cjs run
scripts.package:rune: npm run build:rune && npm run generate:icon && npm run generate:cert && npm run clean:package && node scripts/package-rune.cjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/*.test.cjs && node scripts/build-rune-assets.cjs --check
scripts.test:rune: npm run build:rune-assets && node scripts/cargo.cjs test
